question: Kedu aha emume e ji eri ji ọhụrụ n'ala Igbo?
explanation: Emume Iri Ji bụ emume a ma ama e ji ekele chi maka owuwe ihe ubi ji.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu ihe bụ isi ihe e ji eme emume Iri Ji?
explanation: A na-eji ji ọhụrụ eme emume a iji gosi ekele maka afọ ọma.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu onye na-ebu ụzọ je aṅụ mmanya n'emume Iri Ji?

options.B: Eze ma ọ bụ Eze Ji

explanation: Eze ma ọ bụ onye isi nchichi ka a na-enye ohere ibu ụzọ rie ji na aṅụ mmanya.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu ihe kpatara e ji eme emume n'ala Igbo?
explanation: Emume bụ ụzọ e ji echekwa ma na-akọwapụta omenala ndị Igbo.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu aha otu n'ime emume mmụọ a ma ama n'Igbo?
explanation: Emume Mmanwụ gụnyere ikpughe nka na mmụọ ọdịnala.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu mgbe a na-akarịkarị emume Iri Ji?
explanation: Ọtụtụ obodo Igbo na-eme Iri Ji n'ọnwa Ọgọstụ ma ọ bụ Septemba.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu ihe na-abụkarị akara ugo nke udo n'emume Igbo?
explanation: Akwụkwọ omu na-anọchi anya udo, ịdị ọcha na nnabata ọbịa n'emume.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu ihe onye isi ezinụlọ na-eji agọ ọdị n'emume?
explanation: Oji bụ isi ihe e ji arịrịọ arịrịọ ma gọzie ndị ezinụlọ n'emume ọdịnala.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu ihe Mmanwụ na-anọchi anya ya n'emume ọdịnala?
explanation: A na-ekwere na Mmanwụ bụ nnọchiteanya nke mmụọ nna nna si n'ala mụọ lọta.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu aha chi kere mmadụ n'omenala Okenye gboo?
explanation: Chineke ma ọ bụ Chi bụ aha Okenye gboo nyere onye kere eluigwe na ụwa.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu ihe bụ isi ọrụ arụsị n'okpukpe ọdịnala?
explanation: Arụsị na-ahụ maka ikpe ziri ezi na nchebe obodo n'omenala gboo.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Gịnị ka a na-eji achụ aja n'ala Igbo gboo?
explanation: A na-eji anụ, ji, na mmanya nkwụ achụrụ chi na nna nna anyị ha aja.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu onye na-elekọta arụsị na chi n'obodo gboo?
explanation: Dibia ma ọ bụ Isi mmụọ bụ onye na-egosi ụzọ n'ihe gbasara arụsị.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu ihe bụ 'Ogu' n'okpukpe ọdịnala Igbo?
explanation: Ogu bụ akara ezi omume na ịdị ọcha nke mkpụrụ obi onye kwụ ọtọ.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Gịnị ka 'Ikwa mmụọ' pụtara n'okpukpe gboo?
explanation: Ikwa mmụọ bụ emume a na-eme iji sọpụrụ onye nwụrụ anwụ.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu aha chi nke eluigwe na àmụ̀mà n'omenala ọdịnala?
explanation: Amadioha bụ chi nke àmụ̀mà, égbè eluigwe, na ikpe ziri ezi.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu ihe bụ nzube 'Igo Ọfọ' n'ụtụtụ?
explanation: Igo ọfọ n'ụtụtụ bụ iji rịọ chi nchebe na ngọzi maka ụbọchị ahụ.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Gịnị ka okwu a "Chi" pụtara n'omenala ndị Igbo?

options.B: Onye okike ma ọ bụ onye nchebe

explanation: Chi bụ okwu na-egosi okike ma ọ bụ mmụọ onwe onye na-echebe mmadụ.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu ebe a na-enyekarị Chi nri ma ọ bụ aja?
explanation: A na-enye Chi nri n'ebe pụrụ iche n'obi ma ọ bụ n'ogbire n'ụlọ onye nwe ya.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Gịnị bụ aha e nyere Chi nwoke ma ọ bụ nwanyị n'ezinaụlọ?
explanation: Ndị Igbo na-akpọ Chi ha "Chi m" iji gosi njikọ chiri anya ha na ya.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Gịnị ka a na-eji achụrụ Chi aja kwa afọ ma ọ bụ n'oge pụrụ iche?

options.B: Ji ọhụrụ na okuko ma ọ bụ ewu

explanation: A na-eji ji ọhụrụ, anụ, na ọkụkọ ma ọ bụ ewu achụrụ Chi aja iji kelee ya.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu onye na-egosi ma ọ bụ na-akwado ofufe Chi n'ezinaụlọ?

options.A: Nna n'ezinaụlọ ma ọ bụ onyeisi ya

explanation: Nna ma ọ bụ onyeisi ezinaụlọ bu ibu ọrụ ịchụrụ Chi ezinụlọ aja.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Kedu otu n'ime agwa ndị Igbo kwenyere gbasara mmadụ na Chi ya?

options.A: Chi na mmadụ na-alụ ọgụ mgbe niile

explanation: Nkwenye Igbo bụ na mgbalị mmadụ na-aga n'otu na nke Chi ya.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Gịnị ka ofufe Chi na-egosipụta gbasara nkwenye n'ala Igbo?

options.A: Nkwenye na Chineke na mmụọ onwe onye

explanation: Ofufe Chi na-egosi nkwenye miri emi na mmụọ nchebe onwe onye.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)

question: Gịnị bụ ihe nnọchianya bụ isi a na-eji echeta Chi n'ogbire?

options.A: Osisi ọjị ma ọ bụ ogilisi

explanation: A na-akụ osisi ọjị ma ọ bụ ogilisi n'obi dịka ihe nnọchianya nke Chi.
topic: Emume na Okpukpe Ọdịnala (Festivals and Religion)
